author: IGN
description:
Get your first look at Hidalgo, an upcoming cozy co-op papercraft narrative adventure based on the classic book Don Quijote de La Mancha. 

Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3157950/Hidalgo/

#IGN #Gaming
title: Hidalgo: Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Wildlife Trailer for Death Stranding 2: On The Beach, a third-person action-adventure strand game developed by Kojima Productions. Players will meet a suite of different kinds of wildlife across their adventures to connect Australia to the Chiral Network. Rescue them, deliver them to shelters, and be rewarded for your efforts in Death Stranding 2: On The Beach, launching on March 19 for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) with the game available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Death Stranding 2: On The Beach - Official Wildlife Trailer

author: IGN
description: Don't miss the 60 FPS on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S Trailer for Assassin's Creed Unity, the hit addition to the third-person stealth action-adventure game developed by Ubisoft. Players will embody Arno Dorian in the middle of the French Revolution on a blood-ridden quest to explore the powers that be and add fuel to the flames of a new era for France. 60 FPS is now available in Assassin's Creed Unity for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, with the game being available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, and PC.
title: Assassin's Creed Unity - Official 60 FPS on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S Trailer

author: IGN
description:
The playable demo for Fallosophy, the upcoming minimalist pinball platformer that you'll probably have a tough time peeling yourself away from. Check out this new trailer, and then try it for yourself on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989550/Fallosophy

#IGN #Gaming
title: Fallosophy: Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Sausage Story Trailer for Doomsday Diner, a physics-based chaotic diner management simulator game developed by Space Rock Games. Players will get a close-up and personal look at the journey of a low-key hot dog at the Doomsday Diner from being cooked to consumed. Doomsday Diner is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

#ign #gaming
title: Doomsday Diner - Official Sausage Story Trailer

author: IGN
description: Take a look at the MotoGP 26 announcement trailer for this upcoming simulation motorcycle racing game. In MotoGP 26, take on the 2026 MotoGP season with more authentic riding physics, train like real riders with Ultimate Race Off, and race online with full cross-play when the lights go out. MotoGP 26 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on April 29, 2026.
title: MotoGP 26 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Frankenstein's Monster is getting hitched again! This time The Bride takes center stage in a garish new retelling from director Maggie Gyllenhaal. With Jessie Buckley in the title role, Christian Bale as the monster Frank and a cast rounded out by Peter Sarsgaard, Annette Bening, Jake Gyllenhaal and Penelope Cruz, the classic science fiction icon ditches the lightning struck hairdo and 4 minutes of screen time in 1935, for the lead in a Bonnie and Clyde fueled extravaganza. Critic and author Hanna Flint reviews the latest entry into Frankenstein canon, and talks with IGN's Clint Gage about actors-turned-directors, adapting 200 year old text and whether the movie might actually try to do too much.
title: The Bride Review

author: IGN
description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Karen, a 3D action beat-em-up sandbox game developed by Sauce Studios. Players will embody a disgruntled Karen who's been denied service to her satisfaction, leaving rage to be the only acceptable response. Wreak havoc across the local mall, speak to managers, and destroy everything in sight with physics-driven attacks. Karen is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Karen - Official Reveal Trailer

In this breakout from IGN's Podcast Unlocked episode 731, the crew sits down to share their full impressions of Control Resonant. We dive deep into the new gameplay mechanics and what this new chapter means for the wider Remedy Connected Universe.

#xbox #gaming #controlresonant

author: IGN
description:
Award-winning independent game studio Ember Lab is pleased to share that their critically acclaimed story-driven action adventure game Kena: Bridge of Spirits is coming to Nintendo Switch 2. The new Nintendo version will come feature-complete with the latest updates to the game, including the Anniversary DLC and New Game+ mode.

Kena: Bridge of Spirits will be available globally on Nintendo Switch 2 in Spring 2026. The game is currently available on PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4, and Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One.
title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits - Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Watch the First Look: Tycoon Overview Trailer for Transport Fever 3, a city-building management transportation tycoon simulation game developed by Urban Games. Players will get an extensive look at the new features and gameplay mechanics for the upcoming title, as players will design a transit system to fit cities, towns, and regions for peak efficiency and comfort. Customize a suite of different attributes from industry density, productivity, maintenance costs, subsidy penalties, and more. Transport Fever 3 is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#ign #gaming
title: Transport Fever 3 - Official First Look: Tycoon Overview Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks gets a new trailer and a console announcement. Get another look at gameplay in this latest Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks trailer for this Ork vehicle combat game. Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S in 2026. It is already available on PC.

The PS5 and Xbox versions will include every update, mode, vehicle and DLC released on PC so far. That also includes the full range of maps, weapons, customization options and the WAAAGH! Paths rewards.

#ign #gaming
title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks - Official Console Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Are you doing your part? Enjoy 13 minutes of exclusive gameplay from the Bug Mode of Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War, the upcoming retro-FPS in which, in Bug Mode, you play as the bugs themselves. Check it out when it releases on March 16 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.

#ign #gaming
title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War – Bug Mode Exclusive Gameplay

author: IGN
description:
Have you heard a roar in the sky and wondered what’s falling to the earth? Whether you're trying to knock out your Daily Challenges or seeking out rare furniture from the Gimmighoul museum, Mysterious Feathers are a vital resource in Pokopia. In this guide, we break down exactly how to track the flight paths of Ho-Oh and Lugia, the specific moves you'll need to harvest their feathers, and where to spend them once your bag is full.

Learn how to get Rainbow Feathers and Silver Feathers in Pokopia with our step-by-step walkthrough. We cover everything from spotting the legendary birds to using Water Gun on Ho-Oh’s flames and Cut on Lugia’s tornadoes. This Pokopia gameplay guide also details the location of the Rocky Ridges museum and how to trade your appraised relics and Mysterious Feathers with Gimmighoul for exclusive furniture items.

#IGN #Gaming #Pokemon
title: Pokopia Mysterious Feathers Guide: How to Complete the Daily Challenge

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Sony is reportedly not interested in sharing some of their upcoming first-party titles with PC. Via Bloomberg, the company may hold back some of their single-player titles and keep them PS5-exclusive—titles such as Insomniac's Wolverine and the recent Ghost of Yōtei may not receive PC ports. Multiplayer-focused titles like Marathon, however, will still be released on PC. In other news, Highguard will be taken offline on March 12, just 45 days after it was officially released. In happier news, Resident Evil Requiem may be the franchise's best launch, with around 5 million copies sold in less than a week.

#ign #gaming
title: Sony Has Reportedly Returned to Console Exclusivity - IGN Daily Fix
